title: v2.1.265
content: What's changed Added user.email and user.groups to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway, matching terminal sessions Added support for pointing --plugin-dir at a folder of plugins: each child folder with a manifest loads, and children added or removed while running are picked up Added a 1 GB cap on tool results saved to disk; the in-conversation preview says when a saved file was truncated Fixed resuming a foreground-spawned subagent changing its tool list and system prompt prefix, which broke prompt-cache reuse for that agent Fixed agent teammates and resumed subagents moving SubagentStart hook context and preloaded skills out of the prompt prefix on later turns, which broke prompt-cache reuse Fixed resume after the previous process died while a tool was running: the last prompt is no longer rewritten, and the interrupted tool call is kept and marked interrupted Fixed /model opusplan[1m] being rejected with "Model not found" Fixed syntax-highlighte
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.265 版本更新，新增 --plugin-dir 指向插件文件夹的支持（子文件夹含 manifest 即自动加载，运行时增删可热感知），并为落盘的工具结果加了 1GB 上限与截断提示。同时修复了多项破坏 prompt-cache 复用的问题（前台子代理恢复时工具列表/系统提示前缀变动、agent teammates 与恢复子代理的 SubagentStart hook 上下文与预加载 skills 移出前缀），对重度使用子代理工作流的用户可显著降低成本与延迟。

title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
content: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.
summary_zh: MIT 研究员使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 配合 Codex，让 AI 自主运行量子计算实验、分析结果并校准量子比特。展示了 AI 编程助手在科研自动化场景中的 agentic 工作流应用，是 AI Agent 承担端到端实验闭环的典型案例。

title: fix: close release review gaps and expose failing CI suites
content: fix: close release review gaps and expose failing CI suites
author: haelyra
summary_zh: 这是 everything-claude-code 仓库的一次修复提交，主要收紧发版审查流程中的漏洞并让失败的 CI 测试套件显式暴露出来。附带信息展示了一套学术研究技能插件（ARS）的实际配置：13 个斜杠命令按任务复杂度在 frontmatter 中固定路由到 Opus/Sonnet 不同模型，以及 3 个插件级 agent 的分工。对于想学习 Claude Code 插件化组织、命令级模型路由与成本控制的人有参考价值。

title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
content: Engineers at 1Password use Codex to rapidly build new features and internal tools, reaching production-readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies.
summary_zh: 1Password 工程团队通过 OpenAI Codex 快速构建新功能与内部工具，在严格安全策略约束下达到生产可用水平，官方称工程效率提升 21%。属于 AI 编程工具在安全敏感型企业中的落地案例，可参考其在合规环境下的 AI 编码工作流。但内容为厂商自述的营销型案例，缺乏具体技术细节与可复现方法。
